steps.title: Game created
steps.detail: Central created the game and holds seat 1 while the draft waits for players.

steps.title: Table full
steps.detail: Six players are seated through the creator's approval, and IHasPinecone watches as a spectator.

steps.title: Draft pick
steps.detail: Central picks House Atreides for the draft.

steps.title: Draft pick
steps.detail: Krell picks House Harkonnen for the draft.

steps.title: Draft pick
steps.detail: Jaded AF picks Emperor for the draft.

steps.title: Draft pick
steps.detail: Eichmal picks Spacing Guild for the draft.

steps.title: Draft pick
steps.detail: Ridwan picks Fremen for the draft.

steps.title: Draft pick
steps.detail: Tautrimas picks Bene Gesserit for the draft.

steps.title: Draft ban
steps.detail: Central bans Ixians from the draft.

steps.title: Draft nearly ready
steps.detail: Five seats are ready; Tautrimas has not confirmed yet.

steps.title: Factions dealt
steps.detail: The deal assigned Central (Spacing Guild), Krell (House Atreides), Jaded AF (Fremen), Eichmal (Emperor), Ridwan (House Harkonnen), Tautrimas (Bene Gesserit). Trading opens.

steps.title: Trading
steps.detail: Three seats keep what they were dealt; the others are still deciding.

steps.title: Setup begins
steps.detail: Trading closed and setup opens.

steps.title: Prediction locked
steps.detail: Tautrimas (Bene Gesserit) locks a secret prediction.

steps.title: Traitor selection
steps.detail: The prediction is locked and setup moves on to the Traitors.

steps.title: Traitors gathered
steps.detail: Central combines every Traitor deck into one pile.

steps.title: Traitors shuffled
steps.detail: Central shuffles the Traitor pile.

steps.title: Dealing Traitors
steps.detail: Central has dealt one Traitor to every seat.

steps.title: Traitors dealt
steps.detail: Every seat holds four Traitors in hand.

steps.title: Traitor kept
steps.detail: Central (Spacing Guild) keeps one Traitor and returns three to the pile.

steps.title: Traitors kept
steps.detail: Every faction kept its Traitor, House Harkonnen all four, and confirmed Ready.

steps.title: Starting troops
steps.detail: The map is revealed and every faction places its starting troops.

steps.title: Starting troops
steps.detail: Krell (House Atreides) places 10 troops in Arrakeen.

steps.title: Starting troops
steps.detail: Ridwan (House Harkonnen) places 10 troops in Carthag.

steps.title: Starting troops
steps.detail: Central (Spacing Guild) places 5 troops in Tueks.

steps.title: Starting troops
steps.detail: Jaded AF (Fremen) places 4 troops in Tabr.

steps.title: Starting troops
steps.detail: Jaded AF (Fremen) places 3 troops in False wall south.

steps.title: Starting troops
steps.detail: Jaded AF (Fremen) places 3 troops in False wall west.

steps.title: Starting troops
steps.detail: Tautrimas (Bene Gesserit) places 1 troop in All polar.

steps.title: Setup complete
steps.detail: Every faction has placed its troops and confirmed Ready.

steps.title: Turn 1: Storm
steps.detail: Setup ends and the first turn opens on the Storm phase.

steps.title: Storm moved
steps.detail: Central moves the storm three sectors.

steps.title: Spice Blow
steps.detail: The Spice Blow phase opens.

steps.title: Spice card drawn
steps.detail: Central draws the top Spice card into hand.

steps.title: Spice card played
steps.detail: Central plays the Spice card onto the Spice discard below the deck.

steps.title: Spice card revealed
steps.detail: Central turns the Spice card face up.

steps.title: Spice from the Spice Bank
steps.detail: Central takes the 8 spice the card names from the Spice Bank.

steps.title: Spice placed
steps.detail: Central places 8 spice on Broken Land.

steps.title: CHOAM Charity
steps.detail: The CHOAM Charity phase opens.

steps.title: Bidding
steps.detail: The Bidding phase opens.

steps.title: Card won
steps.detail: Krell (House Atreides) wins the first Treachery card.

steps.title: Bid paid
steps.detail: Krell (House Atreides) pays 2 spice for it.

steps.title: Card won
steps.detail: Eichmal (Emperor) wins the second Treachery card.

steps.title: Bid paid
steps.detail: Eichmal (Emperor) pays 2 spice for it.

steps.title: Revival
steps.detail: The Revival phase opens.

steps.title: Shipment and Movement
steps.detail: The Shipment and Movement phase opens.

steps.title: Shipment
steps.detail: Ridwan (House Harkonnen) ships 5 troops to Arrakeen.

steps.title: Shipment
steps.detail: Central (Spacing Guild) ships 3 troops to Imperial basin.

steps.title: Battle
steps.detail: The Battle phase opens: House Harkonnen and House Atreides share Arrakeen.

steps.title: Battle started
steps.detail: Ridwan (House Harkonnen) opens a battle in Arrakeen.

steps.title: Battle side
steps.detail: Ridwan (House Harkonnen) takes the left side.

steps.title: Battle side
steps.detail: Krell (House Atreides) takes the right side.

steps.title: Battle plan
steps.detail: Ridwan (House Harkonnen) commits a leader; the fixture troops have no battle values to dial.

steps.title: Battle plan
steps.detail: Krell (House Atreides) commits a leader; the fixture troops have no battle values to dial.

steps.title: Battle ready
steps.detail: Ridwan (House Harkonnen) locks the plan.

steps.title: Battle countdown
steps.detail: Krell (House Atreides) locks the plan; the reveal counts down.

steps.title: Battle revealed
steps.detail: Both plans are revealed side by side.

steps.title: Battle outcome
steps.detail: Ridwan (House Harkonnen) agrees House Atreides won.

steps.title: Battle resolved
steps.detail: Krell (House Atreides) agrees; the battle is settled.

steps.title: Spice Collection
steps.detail: The Spice Collection phase opens.

steps.title: Mentat Pause
steps.detail: The Mentat Pause ends the turn.

steps.title: Determining the winner
steps.detail: Central opens the result.

steps.title: Game finished
steps.detail: Central declares House Atreides the winner.
